objective: Add Gemini as a real, configurable external LLM provider behind the existing core/bridge boundary.
constraints: Gemini output is untrusted provider output and must pass the existing parse_intent/Core permission boundary.
No direct access from Gemini to Executor, TransactionSupervisor, constitutional memory, governance, or filesystem mutation.
Do not weaken existing Ollama behavior or VERIFIED criteria.
Use environment/configured credentials; never commit API keys.
Keep provider/network details behind an injected transport where practical so tests remain deterministic.
required_behavior: Gemini is selectable/configurable as a provider.
Valid Gemini transport output can become BridgeResult only through existing validation.
No provider response directly executes a modification.
evidence_required: raw targeted test command and output
regression test result for existing bridge behavior
